events.prompt: Resolve the execution route when Copilot does not attest the underlying model.
events.incorrect_behavior: Assume an OpenAI model and apply an OpenAI-specific prompt overlay.
events.correct_behavior: Keep the implementation semantic profile, use the generic model overlay, and enable only attested Copilot surface capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: The selected model overlay is generic-v1.
The effective execution mode is serial-active-model unless route identity is attested.
